mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1650 thousand units in a 3-month window, it signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing overall economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1650, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%), the labor market is weak, suppressing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.
